import sys,json,hashlib,subprocess,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
ROOT=Path('/Users/yuxianqi/Project/qlib');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
BASE=ROOT/'backtest/experiments/models/training-target/horizon-style-p50-20261105-v1'
PREFIX='stability-20261106';EID='training-target/horizon-style-p50-20261105-v1'
TMP=Path('/private/tmp/qlib-p50-stability-20261106.PleG6F')
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def write(p,d):Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
class Links(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.links=[]
    def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
        for key,value in attrs:
            if key in ['href','src']:self.links.append(value)

if __name__=='__main__':
    state=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-progress.json')
    assert state['status']=='completed' and state['phase']=='closed'
    assert len(state['jobs'])==state['model_fits_started']==8 and len(state['account_jobs'])==3
    assert all(j['status']=='succeeded' for j in state['jobs']+state['account_jobs'])
    assert not TMP.exists()
    assert read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-cleanup.json')['status']=='completed'
    assert read(BASE/'docs/harness-state.json')['status']=='closed'
    c=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-original-comparison.json')['comparisons']
    assert all(x['objective_shared']['exact'] and x['valid_prediction']['exact'] and x['booster_file_exact'] and not x['changed_tree_rounds'] for x in c[:2])
    inference=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-inference.json');assert inference['all_new_reference_annual_predictions_exact']
    prior=read(BASE/'docs/H20-observed-label-effect.json')
    for seed in [42,1000,2000,3000,4000]:
        e=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-old-s{seed}-r1-original.json')['early_stopping'][0]
        p=next(x['old_p50'] for x in prior['seeds'] if x['seed']==seed)
        assert e['best_iteration']==p['best_iteration'] and e['evaluated_iterations']==p['stop_iteration'] and e['best_score']==p['best_score']
    original=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-old-account-gate.json');assert original['passed']
    summary=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-summary.json');assert summary['cumulative_model_fit_launches']==111
    report=BASE/'reports'/f'{PREFIX}.html';page=report.read_text();parser=Links();parser.feed(page)
    for value in parser.links:
        assert '://' not in value and not value.startswith('//'),value
        assert (report.parent/value.split('#',1)[0]).resolve().is_file(),value
    for name in ['old-s5','old-ladder','new-ladder']:
        m=read(BASE/'metrics'/f'{PREFIX}-{name}.json');assert (ROOT/m['session_dir']).is_dir()
        assert (ROOT/m['ensemble']['portable_report']).is_file()
        assert f"{m['ensemble']['full_period']['annualized_return']*100:.2f}%" in page
    adapters=list((BASE/'docs').glob(f'{PREFIX}-adapter-*.json'))
    for path in adapters:
        d=read(path);assert hashlib.sha256(d['source_text'].encode()).hexdigest()==d['source']['sha256']
    for item in read(BASE/'configs'/f'{PREFIX}.json')['frozen_files']:
        p=Path(item['path']);p=p if p.is_absolute() else ROOT/p
        if p.is_relative_to(TMP):continue
        with p.open('rb') as f:assert hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()==item['sha256'],str(p)
    from backtest.scripts.register.experiment_registry import load_registry
    from backtest.scripts.maintenance.experiment_archive import scan_experiment_archives,ensure_experiment_metadata
    rows=load_registry(ROOT/'backtest/experiments/registry.jsonl');row=[r for r in rows if r['exp_id']==EID][-1]
    assert len(rows)==27 and len({r['exp_id'] for r in rows})==24
    assert row['stability_followup']['strict_repeatability_passed']
    assert row['execution_audit']['cumulative_fits']==111
    scan=scan_experiment_archives(ROOT);assert not scan['errors'] and scan['mode']=='typed'
    dry=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'backtest/scripts/maintenance/cleanup_experiment_artifacts.py'),'--result-retention','platform','--only-result'],cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
    cleanup=json.loads(dry.stdout);assert not cleanup['errors'] and not cleanup['delete_result_dirs']
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-result-retention-final.json',cleanup)
    req=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}));platform=json.load(req.open('http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/research',timeout=25))
    assert not platform['warnings'] and len(platform['experiment_records'])==15 and len(platform['benchmarks'])==9
    assert sum(x['id']==EID for x in platform['experiment_records'])==1
    active={x['id'] for x in platform['benchmarks'] if x['current']}
    assert active=={'regime-adapt/m0-h20-t5h5-es-v1','baseline/phase-m-v1-bt-v5'}
    subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
    visual=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-visual-review.json');assert visual['scientific_png_reviewed']
    doc={'status':'passed','model_fits':8,'account_jobs':3,'cumulative_model_fits':111,'within_input_strict_repeatability':True,'all_five_old_seed_selection_summaries_match':True,'all_saved_model_annual_reference_predictions_exact':True,'old_s5_reproduction_gate':original,'report_local_links':len(parser.links),'adapter_source_receipts':len(adapters),'non_temporary_frozen_files_unchanged':True,'typed_archive_errors':scan['errors'],'registry_events':len(rows),'registry_unique_experiments':24,'platform_experiment_entries':15,'platform_benchmarks':9,'platform_warnings':[],'active_baselines':sorted(active),'final_result_cleanup_candidates':0,'temporary_root_absent':True,'git_diff_check':'passed','visual_review':visual,'browser_html_render':'Unavailable due browser file-access restriction; no alternate-browser workaround used. Scientific PNG visually reviewed; HTML numbers and local links statically checked.'}
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-verification.json',doc)
    ensure_experiment_metadata(ROOT,row)
    print(json.dumps(doc,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
